verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's docs describe comprehensive code review on the pull request screen, including reviewing large diffs, viewing third-party code reports, and an AI reviewer that suggests fixes. That clearly covers reviewing code changes online. Inline comment threads and replying to them are only implied by "comprehensive code review features", not stated outright. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline comments and replies on diffs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR review workflow.
